description: Flow State connects ChatGPT to an endurance athlete's training calendar. Users can review upcoming workouts, inspect athlete profile and recovery context, create or update workouts and races, manage training plans, analyze training load and workout history, and sync selected workouts to Garmin when their Flow State account has Garmin connected.
